notes.title: Gazebo Simulator - Edge of Space: Preamble
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550460/cdef057963df7bfa7072eb154d5cfbd8f0bd8afe.jpg

A space elevator has appeared without warning, connecting the world to the void above. What revelations does this bridge to the cosmos harbor?

Laying the Foundation for Level 2: Space Combat

We're setting the stage for our upcoming transition to space combat in Level 2. While the space elevator doesn't have active functionality yet, that's about to change dramatically. This update includes both foundational elements for Level 2 as well as numerous improvements to enhance your current gameplay experience:


 Combat rebalancing for better strategic depth
 Enhanced graphical effects and visual polish
 New musical compositions and audio refinements
 Streamlined user interface improvements


Stay tuned as we prepare our Gazebo for physically-accurate zero gravity combat.
